headline: Sanderson Farms: Beau Hossler shoots 64 to take 36-hole lead at 15-under
whyCareReason: Beau Hossler surges to 15-under par in Jackson with Daniel Berger breathing down his neck in a high-stakes FedExCup Fall shootout.
teaser: Friday at Country Club of Jackson: Beau Hossler cards an 8-under 64 to seize the 36-hole lead at 15-under 129, one shot ahead of Daniel Berger.
story:
Why this one matters: The Country Club of Jackson continued to yield sensational scoring on Friday as Beau Hossler surged to the top of the leaderboard with a flawless 8-under 64.

Hossler caught fire on his second nine, rattling off five birdies in a seven-hole stretch to reach 15-under 129 for 36 holes. The 29-year-old American is seeking his breakthrough PGA Tour victory, but he faces relentless pressure from a resurgent Daniel Berger, who posted his second consecutive 65 to sit just one back at 14-under 130.

Defending champion Kevin Yu remains firmly in contention after backing up his opening 68 with a crisp 6-under 66. With the 36-hole cut falling at 4-under par, the weekend promises a furious race for the 500 FedExCup points and two-year winner exemption.
stakes: Breakthrough PGA Tour victory, 500 FedExCup points, and guaranteed tour status through 2028.
rivalryAngle: Hossler chasing a maiden title against seasoned winners Berger and defending champ Yu in an intense Mississippi shootout.
